description: Color contrast check (WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA) for up to 50 caller-supplied color pairs. No page is fetched. Each pair reports the contrast ratio, AA and AAA for normal and large text, the 3:1 non-text result, and a nearer foreground of the same hue when AA is not met. Price 0.01 USD in USDC on Base, settled after a successful check.
name: check_contrast
